descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在京都吃汤豆腐后画的菜单，小蘸碟比锅还大。
descriptions.en: Drawn after yudofu in Kyoto. The little dipping dish somehow grew larger than the pot.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在京都画的汤叶菜单，薄薄的层次像叠好的信纸。
descriptions.en: A Kyoto yuba sketch whose delicate layers remind the messenger of folded letter paper.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使离开清水寺后补画的京都远景，边上留着一个很努力的长方形。
descriptions.en: A Kyoto view filled in after leaving Kiyomizu-dera, with one very ambitious rectangle at the edge.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在京都吃饭时画的草稿，小锅旁边留着给蘸碟的位置。
descriptions.en: A lunch doodle from Kyoto, leaving room beside a little pot for its dipping dish.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使离开二条城后和旅人各画的一条线，想记住廊道地板的鸣响。
descriptions.en: Two lines drawn after a visit to Nijo-jo, an attempt to remember the corridor floor’s chirp.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使和旅人重遇时接好的原创便签，记着二条城的一段声音，也记着两次见面。
descriptions.en: An original note joined together at a second meeting: a paper memory of Nijo-jo and of seeing someone again.
